fieldValues.title: Implement RFC-037 Revision 4's block-opening scalar row form
fieldValues.summary: format_field_row_text in srs-repository now starts a scalar value on the line after its label when the value's first line opens a block-level construct (fenced code, list item, table row, ATX heading, blockquote, thematic break), per srs#714's accepted RFC-037 Revision 4. Inline values and html are unchanged.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs#580 pool (tick 2026-09-09) after srs#714/PR #715 merged, resolving the blocked_by on srs-rust#973. Added value_opens_block_level and its seven per-construct detector functions (fence, ATX heading, blockquote, unordered list, ordered list, table row, thematic break), applied only to the Scalar arm of format_field_row_text -- Entries and Placeholder forms are unchanged, and html is unaffected by construction ([FR-037-4]). Proved with one test per construct plus an inline-unchanged and an html-unaffected case: reverted the fix, confirmed 9 of 11 new tests fail exactly on the block-opening constructs, restored it, confirmed all 46 RFC-037 tests green. All three workspace gates (build, test, clippy) green by exit code. PR srs-rust#1019 opened with gate:auto-merge armed (mode clear, Door 1). This PR alone produces no docs/spec/** diff in srs -- that requires a new srs-rust release and a pin advance, tracked as a carried_context for whichever unit does that next.
